token-sheriff-client/src/main/java/de/cu.description: Client-authentication strategies for the token endpoint: client_secret_basic, client_secret_post, private_key_jwt and mTLS, selected by ClientAuthenticationSelector.
DPoP (RFC 9449) sender-constrained token support: proof-JWT generation and the constraint-binding model shared with the validation side.

Token lifecycle management: the TokenStore abstraction with an in-memory implementation, proactive refresh scheduling, and token revocation.

Adds token lifecycle management (store, scheduler, id-token validation bridge) on the commons transport base.
